common.noPermission: You are not allowed to do this

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Enter your account details to access the management console.
login.heroTitle: Manage patches across your entire fleet from one place.
login.heroText: Track missing patches, third-party applications and vulnerabilities on Windows and macOS clients, and roll out updates in a controlled way.
login.feature1: Lightweight agent: under 1% CPU when idle
login.feature2: End-to-end security with mTLS and signed actions
login.feature3: Risk prioritization with CVE, KEV and EPSS

auth.rate_limited: Too many failed attempts. Please try again later.
auth.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
auth.forbidden: You are not allowed to perform this action.
auth.csrf: Security check failed. Refresh the page and try again.

errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.conflict: The record is not in a state that allows this action.

home.title: Dashboard
home.readonlyNotice: You are signed in with read-only access. You can view every screen but cannot make changes.
home.noMachines: No machines enrolled yet. Use the details below to install your first agent.
home.agentSetupHint: Installing the agent requires the server address and the CA fingerprint. An administrator creates the registration key.
home.complianceHelp: Share of machines with no missing patches
home.trendEmpty: Trend data builds up over a few days.
home.trendHelp: Daily share of machines with no missing patches

machines.title: Machines
machines.subtitle: All Windows and macOS clients with the agent installed.
machines.searchPlaceholder: Hostname, IP, operating system or OU
machines.rescanQueued: Scan requested for {{count}} machines. Agents start scanning at their next heartbeat.

machine.scanPending: Scan requested ({{time}}); waiting for the agent to report.
machine.noInventoryYet: No inventory has been received from this machine yet. The first scan runs within a few minutes after enrollment.

missing.title: Title
missing.none: No missing updates. The machine is up to date.

machine.vulnsNone: No known vulnerabilities on this machine.

settings.title: Settings
settings.agentSubtitle: These settings reach every agent at its next heartbeat (within a few minutes).
settings.fullIntervalHelp: Full inventory including the missing patch scan. Default: 24 hours.
settings.deltaIntervalHelp: Applications and installed patches are collected again; only changed sections are sent.
settings.cpuLimitHelp: Enforced as a hard cap with a Job Object on Windows; on macOS scans run at background priority.
settings.deferActive: Defer scans while the user is active
settings.deferActiveHelp: Applies to macOS only. Deferrals last at most 4 hours.
settings.cabMissing: wsusscn2.cab was not found on the server. Place the file in the wsus/ folder of the server data directory.
settings.invalid: Check the values: the change scan interval cannot exceed the full scan interval.
settings.readOnly: You can view these settings; changing them requires the Admin role.

vulns.title: Vulnerabilities
vulns.subtitle: CVEs detected on machines; the risk score combines CVSS, EPSS probability and CISA KEV.
vulns.kevHint: Listed in the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog: actively exploited
vulns.kevRansomwareHint: Actively exploited and known to be used in ransomware campaigns
vulns.exploitedHint: Microsoft reports this vulnerability as exploited
vulns.noData: No vulnerability data yet. It appears here once CVE sources are synced and agents report inventory.
vulns.epssHint: Probability of exploitation in the next 30 days (FIRST EPSS)

vuln.unknownRecord: No source record for this CVE yet; it was detected from a missing update's CVE list.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Reports are generated from current data and every export is written to the audit log.

compliance.title: Compliance report
compliance.desc: Missing patches, vulnerabilities, KEV and risk per machine; for management and audit.

vulnerabilities.title: Vulnerability report
vulnerabilities.desc: Fleet-wide CVE list: severity, CVSS, EPSS, KEV, risk and affected machine count.

missing-patches.title: Missing patch report
missing-patches.desc: Machine × missing update list; for deployment planning.

apps.title: Application inventory report
apps.desc: Installed third-party applications, versions and machine counts.

reports.pdfNote: PDFs contain at most 5000 rows; use Excel for larger reports.

cveSettings.title: CVE sources
cveSettings.subtitle: NVD, Microsoft MSRC, CISA KEV and FIRST EPSS data is stored on the server; agents never go to the internet.

feedDesc.nvd: CVSS scores and vulnerable version ranges of third-party applications
feedDesc.msrc: Windows security updates, KB → CVE mapping and fixed builds

cveSettings.syncQueued: Sync started. Large sources (NVD, MSRC) can take a few minutes on the first run.
cveSettings.online: Online (the server connects to the sources directly)
cveSettings.disabled: Sync is disabled in the configuration
cveSettings.rulesHelp: Maps installed application names to NVD products. Custom rules take precedence over the built-in dictionary. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions.

packages.title: Package Library
packages.subtitle: Installation packages ready for deployment. Technicians can only deploy packages from here.

hint.command: Leave empty to use the default for the type. {file} is the full path of the downloaded file.
hint.successCodes: Comma separated; defaults to 0, 1641, 3010 for MSI.
hint.detectName: E.g. ^7-zip — machines with this app at an older version appear under "update required".
hint.dmg: For DMG with an empty command the agent mounts the image, installs the .pkg inside or copies the .app to Applications.

packages.deleteConfirm: Remove "{{name}}" from the library? Past action records are kept.
packages.upToDate: {{count}} machines have this version or newer.
packages.noDetect: No installed-app pattern is defined for this package.

actions.title: Actions
actions.subtitle: Package deployments and command runs. Every action is signed and written to the audit log.
actions.cancelConfirm: Cancel this action? Targets that have not started will not run.
actions.pendingApprovalNotice: Under the four-eyes rule this command is waiting for another administrator's approval.

wizard.title: New action
wizard.bandwidthHint: Global limit: {{kbps}} kbps. You can set a lower value.
wizard.name: Action name (optional)
wizard.approvalNote: Command actions require approval; they do not run until another administrator approves.
wizard.platformMismatch: This package can only be deployed to {{platform}} machines.
wizard.noPermission: You do not have permission for this action type.
wizard.commandHint: Windows: cmd or PowerShell; macOS: sh or zsh. Runs as SYSTEM/root. Up to 32 KB.

transfer.title: Transfer settings
transfer.subtitle: Per-client speed limit for file transfers, upload limit and command approval.
transfer.perClientHint: Default 10,000 kbps (10 Mbps). Applies to package and Windows Update catalog downloads.
transfer.approvalHint: When enabled, a command created by an administrator does not run until another administrator approves it.
